title: Change address with NSW Government
summary: You can update your address for your MyServiceNSW Account and various government services in one place.
intro:

what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account (you can create one before changing your address)

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change your address.

more_info.text: You cannot renew or upgrade your NSW Driver Licence online within 14 days of changing your address online with the NSW Government.

faqs.q: How can I change my address?
faqs.a: You can change your address by selecting the ‘Change online’ button, logging in or creating your MyServiceNSW Account, and following the prompts.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my address?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account and the service(s) you wish to update added to your MyServiceNSW Account.

faqs.q: Are there other ways to change my address?
faqs.a: You can also complete an online form, call 13 77 88, or visit a Service NSW Centre.
